physical.title: JEE-style native parallel beam, finite aperture and ideal lens

interpretation.requestedResult: Simulate native parallel illumination and observed crossing/absorption events for a fully specified synthetic JEE-style optical apparatus.
assumptions: Finite parallel beam with zero divergence is a synthetic fully specified control, not an inferred original JEE source.
The native ideal lens uses its declared geometric focal length. An aperture transmits through its empty gap but blocks on its arms.
Source brightness .08 at density .2 avoids native per-ray saturation.
unknowns: Sampled focal-plane crossings are not a physical point-spread function, image reconstruction, continuous flux or diffraction pattern.
